Purpose
-------
Replace the template `source` value in `.github/actions/policies/workflow_execution.json` with a repository-specific value.

Prerequisites
-------------
- Local clone with `origin` set and write access.
- `git` and optionally `gh` (GitHub CLI) installed and authenticated for opening PRs.

Dry-run (preview)
-----------------
```powershell
$file = '.github\actions\policies\workflow_execution.json'
if (-not (Test-Path $file)) { Write-Host "No $file found; nothing to do."; exit }
$content = Get-Content $file -Raw
Write-Host "Current content preview:`n"; $content | Select-String '"source"' -SimpleMatch

# Show matched source value
$match = ($content | Select-String '"source"\s*:\s*"[^"]+"' -AllMatches).Matches.Value
Write-Host "Found source line(s):"; $match

# Proposed replacement (derived from remote):
$url = git config --get remote.origin.url
if ($url -match '[:/](.+?)/(.+?)(\.git)?$') { $repoName = $matches[2] } else { $repoName = (Get-Item -Path .).Name }
Write-Host "Proposed 'source': \"winccoa-tools-pack/$repoName\""
```

Apply (safe, default)
---------------------
Creates a branch `chore/update-workflow-source`, replaces the `source` value and opens a PR.

```powershell
$file = '.github\actions\policies\workflow_execution.json'
if (-not (Test-Path $file)) { Write-Host "No $file found; nothing to do."; exit }

# Compute new source (allow override via env var)
if ($env:WORKFLOW_SOURCE) { $newSource = $env:WORKFLOW_SOURCE } else {
  $url = git config --get remote.origin.url
  if ($url -match '[:/](.+?)/(.+?)(\.git)?$') { $repoName = $matches[2] } else { $repoName = (Get-Item -Path .).Name }
  $newSource = "winccoa-tools-pack/$repoName"
}

# Create branch
$branch = 'chore/update-workflow-source'
git checkout -b $branch

# Replace source line
$raw = Get-Content $file -Raw
$updated = $raw -replace '"source"\s*:\s*"[^"]+"', "`"source`": `"$newSource`""
$updated | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $file

# Commit and push
git add $file
git commit -m "chore: update workflow_execution source to $newSource" || Write-Host "No changes to commit"
git push --set-upstream origin $branch

# Open PR if gh is available
if (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
  gh pr create --title "chore: update workflow_execution source" --body "Replace template source with $newSource" --head $branch
} else { Write-Host "gh CLI not found; created branch $branch and pushed. Create PR manually." }
```

Notes
-----
- To override the computed `source`, set environment variable `WORKFLOW_SOURCE` before running.
- If your repo uses a different org prefix than `winccoa-tools-pack`, set `WORKFLOW_SOURCE` explicitly.
